name: 47918 · Attica, IN
findings: ZIP 47918 (Attica) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47918 (Attica) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47918 (Attica) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
